title: Yen Has No Cents
description: Not every currency has a minor unit — the yen doesn't split into cents. Confirm invoices billed in JPY report a whole-number amount rather than a fractional or inflated value.
successCondition: Book a shipment, then POST /api/billing/shipments/:shipmentId/invoice with { "currency": "JPY" } returns 201 with invoice.currency "JPY" and invoice.amountCents as a whole number of yen (per docs/api/billing.md, JPY amountCents is a whole yen count, not "yen cents"), computed from the exchange rate constant in the billing currency module rather than a live rate.
hints: The fixed exchange rate constants live in apps/api/src/modules/billing/currency.ts — read them to compute the exact expected amountCents for your shipment's priceCents.
amountCents is an unfortunate field name here; for JPY it's just "amount", not cents — don't divide or multiply by 100 when checking it.
